nom: StriVectin Anti-Wrinkle Peptide Plump Line Filling Bounce Serum

segments.mature: Reviewers who describe themselves as older or mention their age (40s to 80s) frequently report the serum plumps and softens fine lines around the mouth, forehead and eyes, describing gradual but visible improvement over weeks of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who says her skin grew drier with age, report the serum feels hydrating and gentle, with one describing it as having cleared up dry patches almost instantly.
segments.combination: Reviewers with normal-to-combination skin dealing with fine lines, dullness and loss of firmness report the serum sinks in without residue and leaves skin feeling plumped and supple.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive, dry skin reports the serum made a genuine difference, instantly clearing dry patches without irritation.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report their fine lines, especially around the mouth, eyes and forehead, look softer or smaller with weeks of consistent use, including several who specifically credit it with reducing marionette and lip lines; a handful report no visible change after two to six weeks and are still waiting to see results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the serum leaves skin feeling plumped, hydrated and smooth without greasy residue, including one who says it cleared up dry patches almost instantly; one reviewer of the reformulated version reports it left her face dry.

aspects.libelle: Small amount of product for the price
Lightweight, silky texture that layers well
Dispenser can be awkward to use
Brief tingling or cooling sensation on application

I wouldn't go without StriVectin! As I have gotten older my skin has become dryer. The Peptide products act well with the Hyaluronic Serum and Moisturizer + Tripeptide for Eyes. I really appreciate the wide variety of products, something for everyone's needs.

This product was gifted by StriVectin. I have normal/combo skin with fine lines, dullness, loss of firmness and textured areas. I've lost a considerable amount of weight in the last year which has made my face look less plump than before. I love that the package has a pump and that it dispenses the perfect amount for me. The cream is silky in texture and lightweight while still feeling very moisturizing. It sinks in nicely and leaves my skin feeling plumped up and supple without giving a residue feeling. This makes my skin feel so smooth and cared for.
I've been searching for something for my eleven lines and this did the trick on my mature skin. Really plumps. This will be on repeat order.
I just have wrinkles around my mouth and lip area. Used for about 2 months and I don't see any results yet. I use it morning and evening.

Oh my goodness, this product is an absolute game-changer! After a few weeks of using it, my skin feels unbelievably incredible – plumper, more youthful, and my pores and smile lines are visibly smaller. The results were almost immediate, and I can't wait to see even more improvements with continued use. My pores were huge before, but now my skin looks amazing! It's like magic in a bottle. With my sensitive dry skin, this product has truly transformed my life by instantly clearing up dry patches. I am forever grateful for this miracle product! Gifted by Strivectin
